Design Notes

Gavel

Dark walnut with brass accent bands. Resting at an angle on its sound block. The universal authority symbol.

Scales of Justice

Polished brass with gold finial. Two pans balanced on a pillar. Subtle sway animation on idle. The most recognizable legal symbol.

Law Library Wall

Floor-to-ceiling mahogany bookshelf. Alternating red and navy leather-bound law volumes with gold spine lettering. Four shelves, each with 10 books at varying heights. The big statement piece.

Mahogany Executive Desk

Large desk with green leather writing surface inlay. Two sets of three drawers with brass pulls. Deep mahogany finish. The power desk that says "senior partner."

Leather Conference Chair

Brown leather with nailhead brass trim. Lower profile than the executive chair. For the client side of the desk.
